AfterCardExhausted.issue: The self-check and the payout loop are faithful -- `if (card == this && CombatState != null)` (DrumOfBattle.cs:33) == `if card is not self or self.combat is None: return`, and both then gain `Energy.BaseValue` once per play-count iteration. THE PLAY COUNT IS COMPUTED FROM THE WRONG BASE. C# calls `GeneratePlayCount(CombatState, null)` (DrumOfBattle.cs:35), which is `GetEnchantedReplayCount() + 1` fed through `Hook.ModifyCardPlayCount`, followed by `Hook.AfterModifyingCardPlayCount` (CardModel.cs:2015-2021); and `GetEnchantedReplayCount()` is `Enchantment?.EnchantPlayCount(BaseReplayCount) ?? BaseReplayCount` (CardModel.cs:1129-1132). The sim passes a bare `1` into `modify_card_play_count` (drum_of_battle.py:48), dropping `base_replay_count` entirely -- the field Hidden Gem raises (`card.base_replay_count += self._replay`, colorless_skills.py:322) and the field the sim's own normal play path DOES include (`1 + card.base_replay_count`, combat.py:469-470). It also drops the AfterModifyingCardPlayCount notification. Observable: use Hidden Gem on Drum of Battle, then exhaust it -- the game pays out twice, the sim once. LIVE: card/hidden_gem is a ported colorless Skill that raises `base_replay_count` on a chosen card, and Drum of Battle is a ported Uncommon. This is the card half of gap G4's blast radius identified by `py audit/tools/card_probes.py replay`.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (DrumOfBattle.cs:21-24) == cost 1 / SKILL / UNCOMMON / SELF. Drum of Battle has NO Exhaust keyword of its own -- the Exhaust hover tip (DrumOfBattle.cs:13) advertises the TRIGGER -- and the sim correctly leaves `exhausts` False, so the card only pays out when something else exhausts it.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new CardsVar(2)` + `new EnergyVar(2)` (DrumOfBattle.cs:15-19) == both numbers, both declared.

OnPlay.rationale: `CardPileCmd.Draw(choiceContext, DynamicVars.Cards.BaseValue, Owner)` (DrumOfBattle.cs:28) == `DrawCmd.draw(ctx.player, self._cards)`. Playing the card does NOT grant energy on either side.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Energy.UpgradeValueBy(1m)` (DrumOfBattle.cs:45) == `self._energy += 1` (2 -> 3). The CARDS var stays 2 when upgraded on both sides -- checked, because the natural guess is that a draw card upgrades its draw.
